enemy-settings.label: Minimap label per team
enemy-names.body:
Determines when vehicle names of enemy tanks are displayed:
- Only on ALT - only while ALT is pressed,
- Hide on ALT - visible without ALT, hidden with ALT (default),
- Always - vehicle names are always displayed,
- Never - vehicle names are never displayed.
ally-names.body:
Determines when vehicle names of allied tanks are displayed:
- Only on ALT - hidden without ALT, visible with ALT (default),
- Hide on ALT - visible without ALT, hidden with ALT,
- Always - vehicle names are always displayed,
- Never - vehicle names are never displayed.
squad-names.body:
Determines when your own platoon members are labeled (same 4 modes as for
enemies and allies):
- Only on ALT - only while ALT is pressed,
- Hide on ALT - visible without ALT, hidden with ALT,
- Always - always visible (default),
- Never - your own platoon members are never labeled.

These settings apply only to your own platoon. Other allies and enemy platoons are not treated as your own platoon members.

The name shown is chosen in the two dropdowns below:
'Without ALT' and 'With ALT' - player name or vehicle name.
squad-names-no-alt.header: Own platoon member label variable Without ALT
squad-names-no-alt.body:
Name shown for your own platoon members while ALT is not pressed:
- Username - the player name (default),
- Vehicle - the vehicle name.
squad-names-alt.header: Own platoon member label variable With ALT key
squad-names-alt.body:
Name shown for your own platoon members while ALT is pressed:
- Username - the player name,
- Vehicle - the vehicle name (default).
mark-enemy-squads.header: Mark enemy platoons on the minimap
mark-enemy-squads.body: Marks detected enemy platoon members on the minimap with either a star or a superscript platoon number. Choose the marker and its position in the dropdown below.
enemy-squad-star-position.body: Chooses between a star and a superscript platoon number for detected enemy platoons, and places it before, on both sides, or after the vehicle name. The number matches the team-list number.
enemy-squad-star-only.header: Platoon marker also when labels hidden
enemy-squad-star-only.body: Keeps the selected platoon marker visible for detected enemy platoon members even while their vehicle label is hidden by the enemy mode - e.g. while ALT is pressed.
Requires the marker above. Only relevant for 'Only on ALT' or 'Hide on ALT'; unnecessary with 'Always', with 'Never' the markers stay hidden too.
